strategies.name: premarket_level_breakout_or_retest_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Mark the pre-market high and low from 3:00 a.m. EST to the 9:30 a.m. open on the 5-minute chart. Go long above the pre-market high or short below the pre-market low either on a confirmed breakout close with elevated volume on a lower timeframe, or on a subsequent retest of the broken level holdingas
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry/breakout candle or just beyond the retest level. Look for at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trim/scale out and trail the stop to breakeven or into profit as the move continues.

strategies.name: premarket_level_liquidity_sweep_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: When price briefly breaks above the pre-market high or below the pre-market low but then fails and reclaims the level, enter in the opposite direction of the failed break.
